purpose: Describe how a future publisher signature can cover immutable application content while leaving user data editable. No signature in this document authenticates a capsule.

immutable_application_compartment.content_digest: lowercase hexadecimal digest over a canonical manifest and ordered content records

mutable_data_compartment.rule: Mutating these records must not rewrite the immutable application digest. A host may downgrade trust when application content or schema changes.

verification_rules: Canonicalization must be deterministic and independently implementable.
The signature envelope is metadata until a trusted verifier and publisher key policy exist.
Unsigned and modified capsules remain inspectable as ordinary SQLite files.
Hosts must not interpret this preview as an executable trust grant.
